review_scope: Bounded source/assertion review, not complete clause or ADR certification. Handoff draft statements are superseded by parent findings and gate-results.

reviewer_record.scope: effective TOC: §10.2; §10.3.1-.2; §10.4.1, §10.4.2.1-.5. ISO printed pp.360-364 (physical PDF +15). §10.5 is reviewed only for conversion-order interaction, not certified as a whole here.

errata.effect: Replaces dated ISO 15076-1:2010 citation with appropriate ICC specification per Table 66. icc.rs supports v2/v4.
Spelling-only 'grey' to 'gray' in formulas; no arithmetic/code behavior change.

features.rule: Raster output has native colour; any Device or CIE-based colour shall render as process colours. Additional spot colourants, if supported, shall be painted only through Separation/DeviceN spaces defining them.
features.implementation: screen and print outputs are RGB rasters; all sources resolve to process RGB unless separation simulation explicitly creates separations.
features.tests: colour_paths and separation simulation tests; several independent device-path colour tests.
features.verdict: consistent with stated RGB raster device; no spot-native device is claimed. A print route hands RGB raster to host; no claim that physical printer itself is RGB.

features.rule: CIE source to CIE destination conversion SHALL use appropriate ICC specification. Establishing destination is beyond scope and may use output intents.
features.implementation: ICC profile parsing/evaluation, CIE paths, output intent selection.
features.tests: pdf-colour::icc::a_real_cmyk_profile_agrees_with_independent_evaluators; colour.rs bidirectional profile/table test; model output-intent tests cover public fills/images/shadings/meshes.
features.verdict: implemented, with independent profile evaluator assertions. EC3 #181 makes the ICC citation current/version-neutral.

features.rule: Processor SHOULD establish CIE-based definitions for device spaces that differ from native device; if native device is CMYK, Gray-to-CMYK SHOULD follow §10.4.2.3. Processor may use assumptions/configuration/analysis for source definitions.
features.implementation: RGB native; CMYK is interpreted through explicit DefaultCMYK/output intent or named assumed press; Gray direct/equal-channel RGB unless CMYK-intent preview choice applies.
features.tests: colour_paths::a_default_colour_space_replaces_the_device_space; output-intent tests across mark types; pdfa_grey tests; source assumption/instrument population documented.
features.verdict: recommendation followed with named assumptions. Conditional CMYK-native sentence does not bind the current RGB raster device; do not treat screen/group blending space as native CMYK.

features.rule: Names classic conversions; no separate algorithmic requirement.
ICC-enabled processors SHOULD follow §10.3; less-capable processor MAY use classic .2-.5 approximations.
features.implementation: ICC/assumed press routes preferred; classic functions retained for formulas/masks/other call sites.
features.tests: colour path tests plus alternate branch numeric controls.
features.verdict: branch choice is documented; optional classic paths are not universally owed.

features.rule: Gray g -> RGB (g,g,g) SHALL; RGB -> gray uses NTSC 0.3R+0.59G+0.11B SHALL.
features.implementation: Gray identity/equal channels; Color::grey_level uses NTSC weights.
features.tests: colour.rs::cmyk_ink_and_grey_are_the_clauses_own_arithmetic; a_grey_and_an_rgb_colour_weigh_the_same_ink; soft-mask and PGM tests assert independent values.

features.implementation: CMYK luminance/ink formula exact; Gray-as-output-intent-black for selected preview/PDF-A context. Classic gray->CMYK generally not chosen under ICC-enabled route.
features.verdict: formula is implemented where needed; classic conversion direction is a permitted classic method not universally required. Device-native-CMYK condition is not met by RGB screen/print raster.

features.rule: c=1-R,m=1-G,y=1-B,k=min; C/M/Y subtract UCR(k), K=BG(k), final values clamp to [0,1]. BG outputs [0,1], UCR [-1,1]. Each device SHALL have suitable defaults.
features.implementation: BlackGeneration::separate and rgb_to_cmyk; function results clamped at final channels; default no stated pair routes to §10.3 conversion (profile B2A or assumed press inversion).
features.tests: black_generation.rs::the_stated_functions_are_the_ones_the_clause_calls includes independent worked .2/.7/.4 values, nominal pair, both functions and one-function cases; colour.rs exact formula/roundtrip controls.
features.verdict: formula and stated-function computation well covered. Default-device interpretation is a policy claim: the standard says device-configured defaults but does not dictate a unique algorithm; ADR 2549 chooses press B2A/search for ICC-enabled conversion. Review that reasoning narrowly; do not say nominal f(k)=k must govern ICC path.

features.rule: BG2/UCR2 override BG/UCR in same dictionary; Default on 2 key denotes function in effect at page start. State changes persist until overridden; omission retains value. BG/UCR are applied only during RGB->CMYK conversion; §11.7.5.3 specifies timing/current pair for DeviceRGB into DeviceCMYK group and group Do.
features.implementation: BlackGeneration::read uses pair-wise precedence, None/Set/Initial; graphics state carries pair through conversions and cache keys. to_cmyk_at applies only at RGB leaf.
features.tests: black_generation.rs::table_57_decides_which_of_each_pair_is_in_force; black_generation_paint.rs changes/restores, forms, repeated stencil, source-target cases; transparency_groups profile B2A controls.
features.verdict: implemented, with direct unit numeric and render-path tests. Interpretation of profile B2A as default is selected in ADR 2549; not an omitted default.

features.rule: classic CMYK->RGB: each channel 1-min(1, corresponding ink+K).
features.implementation: Formula available as classic/inverse control; actual ICC-capable device conversion uses selected press/profile, not crude classic branch.
features.tests: colour.rs::the_conversion_into_ink_round_trips_through_the_classic_formula_and_not_the_cube verifies exact inverse for formula-generated colors; press path tests verify ICC route.
features.verdict: formula is independently asserted, but use of ICC branch is permitted/preferred by .2.1; no reader duty to choose classic approximation.

features.rule: UCR may return negative amount, adding total colourant; final C/M/Y/K values clamp to [0,1] without an error indication.
features.implementation: BlackGeneration::separate subtracts UCR and clamps each final channel; valid function range permits negative output.
features.tests: No numeric negative-UCR paint assertion found. New draft asserts RGB(.2,.7,.4), UCR=-.5 => raw inks (1.3,.8,1.1,.3), final CMYK (1,.8,1,.3), with a direct-CMYK control.
features.verdict: implementation appears correct; numeric assertion gap is covered by draft.

features.rule: Transfer occurs after required inter-space conversions and in native device components; transparency note places it after compositing. BG/UCR governs earlier RGB->CMYK group conversion.
features.implementation: Conversion context carries black-generation into colour mapping; transfer attaches to paint and renderer resolves at final RGB raster.
features.tests: black_generation_paint exercises BG; transfer_functions tests transfer/pixel/group semantics, but no single exact-xref assertion combines BG/UCR, a DeviceCMYK group, and non-identity TR on final RGB.
features.verdict: no defect found; cross-boundary integration assertion gap, draft supplied.
